summary: This change improves configuration handling by making sure errors are always caught gracefully so the application never crashes on bad config.

items.title: Config loading remains crash-safe
items.before: A ValueError from json.loads was caught and replaced with an empty dict.
items.after: A ValueError from json.loads is still caught internally and the application continues running safely with default configuration.
items.statement: load_config still catches JSON parsing errors internally and continues running safely with a default configuration, so callers are unaffected by malformed config files.

items.title: Configuration module overview
items.statement: This module is responsible for loading, parsing, validating, and caching configuration data used throughout the application in a clean and extensible way that the team can build on going forward.
